thread:
Ethan Park: hey team, first week here — trying to run the quickstart in us-east1 but hitting permission errors when listing compute instances and i also can't see the billing account in GCP. who do i ping for regional/billing perms? :wave:

Ethan Park: gcloud output:```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.list) PERMISSION_DENIED: User does not have permission to list instances on project redwood-us-dev
```

Ethan Park: AWS console also shows AccessDenied for the Billing dashboard, so both clouds look blocked.

liz_it: welcome Ethan! :tada: did onboarding add you to infra-us or just the general engineering group? infra-us -> project viewer roles and billing mapping.

Ethan Park: only "engineering" per the onboarding email. i filled the distro form but didn't see infra-us mentioned.

morgan_cloud: hi Ethan — for quick unblocks you'll need `roles/browser` + `roles/compute.viewer` on the GCP project. For billing visibility either `billing.viewer` on the billing account or membership in billing-viewers group. On AWS we map InvoiceReadOnly via SSO.

liz_it: i've opened ticket ONB-942 to add you to infra-us and billing-viewers. infra-bot will track it.

infra-bot: Ticket ONB-942 created by liz_it for user Ethan Park — "Add infra-us SSO and billing-viewers". Priority: P3. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-942

morgan_cloud: while IT handles SSO, i can grant a short-lived `roles/compute.viewer` on redwood-us-dev so you can complete the quickstart. will log expiry.

morgan_cloud: granted `roles/compute.viewer` on project redwood-us-dev to ethan.park@redwood.com for 2 hours.

Ethan Park: listing works now, i can see the test VM and ssh in  huge help, thanks! :relieved:

Ethan Park: any quick way to verify when billing access comes through? want to avoid pinging again.

liz_it: once you're added to billing-viewers you'll see the billing account under Console -> Billing. CLI quick-check:```
gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-us-dev --format="value(billingAccountName)"
```
If that prints a billingAccounts/... string you're linked. Also give SSO ~10 mins to propagate.

Ethan Park: perfect. small onboarding note: the quickstart didn't say to wait for SSO group propagation or which CLI commands to run to check membership. saved me a little head-scratching.

liz_it: great feedback, i'll add a one-liner to the onboarding checklist: "Confirm infra SSO group membership and billing link; allow 10-15m for propagation; verify with `gcloud projects get-iam-policy` and `gcloud beta billing projects describe`."

Ethan Park: thanks everyone, really appreciate the fast help. excited to get into Platform! :sparkles:
